title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Slab Access Already Paid on a Linked Request
content:
# Slab Access Already Paid on a Linked Request

Claims desk adjudication note, Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans, interior lines beneath a slab or foundation.

## Rule

The slab recall offset acts on the slab access figure, and the interior occurrence benefit still open limits the result after it. For a recall reported no later than the plan's repair guarantee days after the most recent completed repair on the same line, the slab access payment is the slab access figure less the slab access payments already authorized on the request of that completed repair, never below zero; for a new failure reported no more than the slab continuation days after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same line, the slab access payment is the slab access figure less the slab access payments already authorized on that temporary-repair request, never below zero; every other slab access payment is the slab access figure in full.

## Figures the rule turns on

- **Repair guarantee days:** 180 calendar days on every Utility Line Protection Plan (Exterior Water Service Line, Exterior Electrical Line, Exterior Sewer and Septic Line, Interior Plumbing and Drainage, Water and Sewer Line Bundle, Total Home Lines).
- **Slab continuation days:** 14 calendar days.

## Decision table

| Service request | Read in the claim history | Slab access payment before the open-benefit limit |
|---|---|---|
| recall, reported on or before day 180 after the most recent completed repair on the same line | slab access payments authorized on the request of that completed repair | the slab access figure less those payments, never below zero |
| new failure, reported on or before day 14 after a temporary repair was authorized on another request for the same line | slab access payments authorized on that temporary-repair request | the slab access figure less those payments, never below zero |
| any other request | nothing further | the slab access figure in full |

## Boundary cases

- A recall reported on day 180 after the completion takes the offset; a recall reported on day 181 is paid the figure in full.
- A new failure reported on day 14 after the temporary repair was authorized takes the offset; one reported on day 15 is paid the figure in full.

## Hypothetical examples

- Slab access figure $500.00; $300.00 of slab access already authorized on the request of the completed repair: $200.00 before the open-benefit limit.
- Slab access figure $500.00; $650.00 already authorized on that request: the difference is below zero, so $0.00.
- A new failure with no temporary repair on another request for the line in the last 14 days: the figure in full.
